BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 560,426 ordinary shares as part of its share repurchase program, with transactions occurring between April 27, 2026, and May 1, 2026. The shares were acquired at prices ranging from 63.80 pence to 68.70 pence, with a volume-weighted average price of 67.15 pence. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, and the company's total issued ordinary share capital now stands at 351,040,356 shares, with 5,717,911 held in treasury. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 05 May 2026 05 May 2026 'Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 27 April 2026 28 April 2026 29 April 2026 30 April 2026 01 May 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 0 241,774 139,333 89,609 84,850 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 0.00 68.60 68.00 67.70 68.70 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 0.00 63.80 64.40 65.90 67.40 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 0.0000 65.8586 67.2617 67.1543 68.4938 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 351,040,356 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 5,717,911 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 345,322,445 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
